annotationBudget.finding: B9 evidence was lost in run 42729776775 (head 39ee8c9) without any CI failure: the B0-B8 steps in the shared job emit exactly 50 annotations, so the new batch was dropped at the cap. The uploaded artifact did contain the report, but its blob host is unreachable here, which is why the annotation channel is the recovery path and why a silent drop had to be made structurally impossible. The batch now runs in its own job and the recorder emits a trailing count marker that recovery must match before the payload is trusted.

The committed report is the recovered CI run; no cross-environment equality claim is made.
